description:
CCleaner for PC helps you clean up your Windows computer, optimize performance, and maintain your online privacy.

Inject instant speed into your machine by freezing resource-hogging apps and programs and by removing the unnecessary files taking up room on your hard drive. Clear out errors, broken settings, and update drivers to improve stability. Protect your privacy by securely erasing tracking cookies and history.
Expanding our cleaning
- Custom Clean follows your choices. Right-click ‘Scan’ and ‘Clean’ options now run only the selected rules.
- Clearer Duplicate Finder results. When some duplicate files can’t be deleted, Duplicate Finder now shows which files were removed instead of displaying a generic error.
Enhancing our Uninstaller
- Clearer Uninstaller text. We updated the wording throughout Uninstaller to make it more consistent and easier to understand.
Simplifying the app
- Smoother startup. We removed a brief flash that could appear while CCleaner was opening.
- Improved window resizing. We fixed a white stripe at the top of the window and improved resizing from the top edge.
Keeping you safe
- Stronger security. We improved how CCleaner protects local communication, handles files, and manages dependencies to help keep your PC and data safer.
Fixing bugs
- Arabic scan display fixed. The scan progress percentage no longer appears mirrored when you use CCleaner in Arabic.
- Tray icon setting fixed. Turning off “Show tray icon” now reliably hides the icon.
- Better accessibility. We improved screen-reader announceme
